These bored members of the upper classes wage war from mobile fortresses and view the battlefield as their playground. Few in number, the Titan Lords usually offer their services as mercenaries, but on the rare occasions when they fight together, their armies of massive walkers are a spectacle to behold. With little fear of consequences for their actions, Titan Lords often wander from one battlefield to the next, seeking some sort of thrill or purpose that is lacking in their pampered lives. Within a relatively short time, humanity has managed to build up a large industrial base in their colonies throughout the Sirius Sector, and most of these are owned by a handful of powerful companies.... [Read more lore on our website](https://www.onepagerules.com/factions/titan-lords) ### Army-Wide Special Rules Honor Code: If a unit where all models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken. ### Special Rules Delayed Action: Once per round, if your opponent has more units left to activate than you, then this model's unit may pass its turn instead of activating (may still be activated later). Fortified: When units where all models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0). ### Aura Special Rules Read more ### Spells Psy-Injected Courage (1): Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to morale test rolls once (next time the effect would apply). Electric Tempest (1): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 2 hits with AP(1) and Surge. Roll as many dice as hits to see if "on rolls of 6" effects trigger. Calculated Foresight (2): Pick up to two enemy units within 18", which friendly units gets Relentless against once (next time the effect would apply). Searing Burst (2): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 6 hits. Shock Speed (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which moves +2" when using Advance actions and +4" when using Rush/Charge actions once (next time the effect would apply). Expel Threat (3): Pick one enemy model within 18", which takes 6 hits with AP(1). This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1]. ### Units ### Vehicles / Monsters Vassal Micro-Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 200pts Heavy Hammer(A1, AP(1), Blast(3)), Stomp(A3, AP(1)) Fear(1), Fortified, Honor Code, Tough(9) Errant Mini-Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 295pts Heavy Hammer(A2, AP(1), Blast(3)), Stomp(A4, AP(1)) Fear(2), Fortified, Furious, Honor Code, Tough(12) Pilgrim Mini-Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 360pts Fusion Blaster(24", A1, AP(4), Deadly(6)), Stomp(A4, AP(1)) Fear(2), Fortified, Honor Code, Tough(12) Yeoman Mini-Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 455pts 2x Fusion Blaster(24", A1, AP(4), Deadly(6)), Stomp(A4, AP(1)) Fear(2), Honor Code, Relentless, Tough(12) ### Titans Paladin Light Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 495pts Hull-Fuser(12", A1, AP(4), Deadly(3)), Heavy Hammer(A2, AP(1), Blast(3)), Stomp(A6, AP(2)) Fear(3), Fortified, Honor Code, Tough(18) Questor Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 715pts Hull-Fuser(12", A1, AP(4), Deadly(3)), Stomp(A8, AP(2)), Titan Hammer(A4, AP(1), Blast(3)) Fear(4), Fortified, Furious, Honor Code, Tough(24) Knight Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 840pts Titan Fusion Cannon(24", A2, AP(4), Deadly(6)), Hull-Fuser(12", A1, AP(4), Deadly(3)), Stomp(A8, AP(2)) Fear(4), Fortified, Honor Code, Tough(24) Duke Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 1030pts 2x Titan Fusion Cannon(24", A2, AP(4), Deadly(6)), Hull-Fuser(12", A1, AP(4), Deadly(3)), Stomp(A8, AP(2)) Fear(4), Honor Code, Relentless, Tough(24) King Heavy Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 1130pts Twin Shoulder-Cannon(24", A2, AP(1), Blast(3)), 2x Titan Harpoon Cannon(18", A1, AP(4), Deadly(9)), Twin Hull-Fuser(12", A2, AP(4), Deadly(3)), Stomp(A10, AP(3)) Fear(4), Honor Code, Tough(30) Images: -
